hinder progress: Constant changes in the rules only hinder progress and make it harder for the team to finish on time.
規則不斷變動只會阻礙進展，讓團隊更難準時完成工作。
hinder development: A lack of clean water and good schools can seriously hinder development in poor rural areas.
缺乏乾淨的水和好的學校，會嚴重妨礙貧窮鄉村地區的發展。
be hindered by: The rescue efforts may be hindered by heavy snow, so the climbers might not be reached until tomorrow.
救援行動可能會受大雪阻礙，所以登山客可能要到明天才能被救到。
hint at a change: The manager's latest email seemed to hint at a change in the company's holiday policy next year.
經理最新的電子郵件似乎暗示公司明年的休假制度會有所改變。
take the hint: I kept yawning and looking at the clock, but my guest didn't take the hint and stayed until midnight.
我一直打哈欠又看時鐘，但我的客人沒有會意，一直待到半夜。
a hint of garlic: The soup tastes wonderful, with a hint of garlic and a little fresh pepper on top.
這碗湯非常好喝，帶有一點蒜味，上面還灑了一些新鮮胡椒。
hire a lawyer: After the car accident, the family decided to hire a lawyer to help them deal with the insurance company.
車禍之後，那家人決定聘請律師來幫他們處理與保險公司的事。
hire a car: When we visit Australia, we plan to hire a car for a week, which costs about forty dollars a day.
我們去澳洲時，打算租車一個星期，一天大約要四十美元。
hire and fire: As the new department head, she has the power to hire and fire staff without asking her boss first.
身為新任部門主管，她有權聘用與解雇員工，不必先詢問老闆。
for hire: At the lake, small boats are for hire by the hour, so visitors can row around and enjoy the view.
在湖邊，小船按小時出租，讓遊客可以划船四處遊覽、欣賞風景。
hit the road: We should hit the road early tomorrow morning to avoid the heavy traffic on the first day of the holiday.
我們明天應該一早上路，以避開連假第一天的嚴重塞車。
hit the books: With final exams starting next week, I really need to stop playing games and hit the books.
期末考下星期就要開始了，我真的需要停止打電動，開始用功讀書。
hit a record high: Housing prices in the city hit a record high last month, making it even harder for young people to buy homes.
這座城市的房價上個月創新高，讓年輕人更難買得起房子。
hit the headlines: The young singer's surprising decision to quit music hit the headlines around the world.
那位年輕歌手決定退出樂壇的驚人決定登上了全球頭條。
hit it off: I think you two will hit it off, since you both love hiking, cooking, and old movies.
我覺得你們兩個會一見如故，因為你們都喜歡健行、做菜和看老電影。
hit the target: Our sales team worked overtime all month and finally managed to hit the target of selling 500 phones.
我們的業務團隊整個月都在加班，終於達成賣出五百支手機的目標。
the recession hit hard: When the recession hit hard, many small shops in our town were forced to close within a few months.
經濟衰退重創時，我們鎮上許多小商店在幾個月內就被迫關門。
hit upon an idea: While walking in the park one afternoon, the writer suddenly hit upon an idea for her new novel.
某天下午在公園散步時，那位作家突然想到了新小說的點子。
hold a meeting: The principal will hold a meeting with all the teachers on Friday to discuss the new school rules.
校長星期五將與全體老師開會，討論新的校規。
hold one's breath: The diver can hold his breath for more than three minutes while swimming deep under the sea.
那位潛水員在深海游泳時，可以屏息超過三分鐘。
hold the record: Ten years later, she continues to hold the record for the fastest time in the school's 100-meter race.
十年後，她仍然保持著學校百米賽跑最快時間的紀錄。
hold a view: Many experts hold a view that differs from the government's, believing that the new tax will hurt small businesses.
許多專家持有與政府不同的看法，認為新稅制會傷害小型企業。
hold someone responsible: If anything in the classroom gets broken, the teacher will hold someone responsible, so please be careful.
如果教室裡有任何東西被弄壞，老師會要某人負責，所以請小心。
hold true: The old saying that practice makes perfect seems to hold true for learning a new language.
「熟能生巧」這句老話，對學習新語言來說似乎是成立的。
hold one's tongue: Although she was angry about the unfair decision, she decided to hold her tongue and not argue with her boss.
雖然她對這個不公平的決定很生氣，她還是決定閉嘴，不和老闆爭吵。
hold the line: Despite strong pressure from some parents, the principal decided to hold the line on the new phone rules.
儘管受到部分家長的強大壓力，校長仍決定在新的手機規定上堅守立場。
hollow out a log: The villagers used simple tools to hollow out a log and turn it into a small canoe for fishing.
村民用簡單的工具挖空木頭，把它做成一艘捕魚用的小獨木舟。
hollow promises: Voters are tired of hollow promises from politicians who forget them as soon as the election is over.
選民已經厭倦了政客的空洞承諾，選舉一結束他們就忘得一乾二淨。
a hollow victory: Winning the case was a hollow victory, because the long legal fight had cost him his family and his savings.
打贏這場官司是空洞的勝利，因為漫長的訴訟讓他失去了家庭和積蓄。
hollowed out by job losses: The once busy mining town has been hollowed out by job losses, leaving empty streets and closed shops behind.
這個曾經熱鬧的礦業小鎮因失業而空洞化，只留下空蕩的街道和關閉的商店。
